```{r}
# ── REPLICATION NOTE ─────────
# The raw IPUMS ACS extract (data1.csv.gz, ~5.1 GB) is too large to include
# in this repository. To reproduce loaded_data_partial.rds from scratch:
#
# 1. Go to https://usa.ipums.org and create an extract with the following:
#    Samples : 2000 5%, 2001–2004 ACS, 2020–2024 ACS  (10 samples total)
#    Variables: YEAR, SAMPLE, SERIAL, CBSERIAL, HHWT, CLUSTER, STRATA, GQ,
#               PERNUM, PERWT, FAMSIZE, SEX, AGE, RACE, RACED, HISPAN,
#               HISPAND, BPL, BPLD, ANCESTR1, ANCESTR1D, ANCESTR2, ANCESTR2D,
#               YRNATUR, YRIMMIG, YRSUSA1, LANGUAGE, LANGUAGED, SPEAKENG,
#               RACASIAN, RACBLK, SCHLTYPE, EMPSTAT, EMPSTATD, INCTOT, INCWAGE
#    Format   : .csv, Rectangular (person)
#
# 2. Place the downloaded file at raw/data1.csv.gz relative to this .Rmd.
#
# 3. Run the chunk below to generate the .rds:
#
# library(data.table)
# data_raw <- fread("raw/data1.csv.gz",
#                   select = c("YEAR","INCTOT","LANGUAGE","AGE",
#                              "SEX","RACE","EMPSTAT"))
# saveRDS(data_raw, "loaded_data_partial.rds")
#
# The resulting loaded_data_partial.rds (~310 MB) is included in the repository
# and is what the analysis chunks below load directly.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center",
                      fig.width = 6.5,
                      fig.height = 4)

library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(modelsummary)
library(scales)

options(modelsummary_format_numeric_latex = "plain")
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')
```

```{r}
data <- readRDS("loaded_data_partial.rds")
```

```{r}
dim(data)
names(data)
```


```{r}
data <- data[EMPSTAT %in% c(1, 2) & INCTOT > 0 & AGE >= 22 & AGE <= 64]
dim(data)

data <- data[, race_label := factor(RACE,
  levels = 1:9,
  labels = c("White",
             "Black",
             "American Indian/Alaska Native",
             "Chinese",
             "Japanese",
             "Other Asian/Pacific Islander",
             "Other race",
             "Two races",
             "Three+ races"))]


data <- data[, sex_label := factor(SEX,
  levels = c(1,2),
  labels = c("Male", "Female"))]
```

```{r}
data[, chinese := ifelse(LANGUAGE == 43, 1, 0)]

data[, .N, by = chinese]

table(data$chinese)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
data <- data[sample(.N, 500000)]
```

```{r}
table2 <- data[, .(mean_income = mean(INCTOT, na.rm = TRUE),
         median_income = median(INCTOT, na.rm = TRUE),
         mean_age = mean(AGE, na.rm = TRUE),
         n = .N), 
     by = chinese]

kable(table2)
```

```{r}
data[, log_income := log(INCTOT)]
modelsimp <- lm(log_income ~ chinese, data = data)

summary(modelsimp)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(chinese, labels = c("Cannot Speak Chinese", "Can Speak Chinese")), y = INCTOT)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "Language Ability",
       y = "Income (log)",
       title = "Income Distribution by Chinese Language Status") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r}
modelcomp <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + race_label + factor(YEAR),
                data = data)
summary(modelcomp)
```

```{r}
modelsummary(list("Simple" = modelsimp))
modelsummary(list("With Moderators" = modelcomp),
             coef_map = c("chinese" = "Speaks Chinese",
                          "AGE" = "Age",
                          "sex_labelFemale" = "Female",
                          "race_labelBlack" = "Black",
                          "race_labelAmerican Indian/Alaska Native" = "Indigenous",
                          "race_labelChinese" = "Asian, Chinese",
                          "race_labelJapanese" = "Asian, Japanese",
                          "race_labelOther Asian/Pacific Islander" = "AAPI",
                          "race_labelOther race" = "Other",
                          "race_labelTwo races" = "Biracial",
                          "race_labelThree+ races" = "Multiracial (3+)"))

modelsummary(list("No Controls" = modelsimp,
                  "With Controls" = modelcomp),
             coef_map = c("chinese" = "Speaks Chinese",
                          "AGE" = "Age",
                          "sex_labelFemale" = "Female",
                          "race_labelBlack" = "Black",
                          "race_labelAmerican Indian/Alaska Native" = "Indigenous",
                          "race_labelChinese" = "Asian, Chinese",
                          "race_labelJapanese" = "Asian, Japanese",
                          "race_labelOther Asian/Pacific Islander" = "AAPI",
                          "race_labelOther race" = "Other",
                          "race_labelTwo races" = "Biracial",
                          "race_labelThree+ races" = "Multiracial (3+)"),
             stars = TRUE,
             statistic = "({std.error})")
```

```{r}
m1 <- lm(log_income ~ chinese, data = data)
m2 <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE, data = data)
m3 <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label, data = data)
m4 <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + race_label, data = data)
m5 <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + race_label + factor(YEAR), data = data)

summary(m1)
summary(m2)
summary(m3)
summary(m4)
summary(m5)
```

```{r}
modelsummary(list("Chinese only" = m1,
                  "+ Age" = m2,
                  "+ Sex" = m3,
                  "+ Race" = m4,
                  "+ Year" = m5),
             stars = TRUE,
             statistic = "({std.error})",
             output = "markdown",)
```

Interaction model to see impact on each racial group
```{r}
lm(log_income ~ chinese * race_label + AGE + sex_label + factor(YEAR), data = data)
```

year split
```{r}
data_early <- data[YEAR <= 2004]
data_late  <- data[YEAR >= 2020]

lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + race_label, data = data_early)
lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + race_label, data = data_late)
```

```{r}
data_chinese_race <- data[race_label == "Chinese"]

early_ch <- data_chinese_race[YEAR <= 2004]
late_ch  <- data_chinese_race[YEAR >= 2020]

lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label, data = early_ch)
lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label, data = late_ch)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

data[, period := ifelse(YEAR <= 2004, "2000-2004", "2020-2024")]

coeffs_period <- data %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + race_label, data = .)
    data.frame(coef = coef(model)["chinese"])
  })

ggplot(coeffs_period, aes(x = period, y = coef)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Effect of Speaking Chinese on Income by Period",
       y = "Coefficient on Chinese",
       x = "Period") + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.3, 0))
```

Sample 2
```{r}
set.seed(123)

# start from the full filtered data, not your already-sampled 500k object
data_full <- fread("raw/data1.csv.gz",
                   select = c("YEAR", "INCTOT", "LANGUAGE", "AGE", "SEX", "RACE", "EMPSTAT"))

data_full <- data_full[EMPSTAT %in% c(1, 2) & INCTOT > 0 & AGE >= 22 & AGE <= 64]

data_full[, race_label := factor(RACE,
  levels = 1:9,
  labels = c("White",
             "Black",
             "American Indian/Alaska Native",
             "Chinese",
             "Japanese",
             "Other Asian/Pacific Islander",
             "Other race",
             "Two races",
             "Three+ races"))]

data_full[, sex_label := factor(SEX,
  levels = c(1, 2),
  labels = c("Male", "Female"))]

data_full[, chinese := ifelse(LANGUAGE == 43, 1, 0)]
data_full[, log_income := log(INCTOT)]

# number of robustness draws
n_draws <- 5

results <- lapply(1:n_draws, function(i) {
  samp <- data_full[sample(.N, 500000)]
  
  model <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + race_label + factor(YEAR),
              data = samp)
  
  data.frame(
    draw = i,
    coef_chinese = coef(model)["chinese"],
    se_chinese = summary(model)$coefficients["chinese", "Std. Error"])})

robust_results <- do.call(rbind, results)
robust_results
```

```{r}
rownames(robust_results) <- NULL
robust_results

ggplot(robust_results, aes(x = factor(draw), y = coef_chinese)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(robust_results$coef_chinese), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Robustness Across Random 500k Samples",
    x = "Random draw",
    y = "Coefficient on Chinese")
```


Chinese Race Subsample
```{r}
data_chinese_race <- data[race_label == "Chinese"]

m_chinese_simple <- lm(log_income ~ chinese, data = data_chinese_race)
m_chinese_full <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + factor(YEAR), 
                     data = data_chinese_race)

modelsummary(list("Chinese Race, No Controls" = m_chinese_simple,
                  "Chinese Race, With Controls" = m_chinese_full),
             coef_map = c("chinese" = "Speaks Chinese",
                          "AGE" = "Age",
                          "sex_labelFemale" = "Female"),
             stars = TRUE,
             statistic = "({std.error})")
```

Does Chinese langauge penalty vary by race?
```{r}
m_interact <- lm(log_income ~ chinese * race_label + AGE + sex_label + factor(YEAR),
                 data = data)

modelsummary(list("Interaction Model" = m_interact),
             coef_map = c("chinese" = "Speaks Chinese (ref: White)",
                          "chinese:race_labelBlack" = "Chinese x Black",
                          "chinese:race_labelChinese" = "Chinese x Asian Chinese",
                          "chinese:race_labelJapanese" = "Chinese × Japanese",
                          "chinese:race_labelOther Asian/Pacific Islander" = "Chinese × AAPI",
                          "chinese:race_labelOther race" = "Chinese × Other",
                          "chinese:race_labelTwo races" = "Chinese × Biracial",
                          "chinese:race_labelThree+ races" = "Chinese × Multiracial"),
             stars = TRUE,
             statistic = "({std.error})")
```

Year-split Comparison
```{r}
data_early <- data[YEAR %in% c(2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004)]
data_late  <- data[YEAR %in% c(2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)]

m_early_simple <- lm(log_income ~ chinese, data = data_early)
m_early_full   <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + race_label, 
                     data = data_early)

m_late_simple <- lm(log_income ~ chinese, data = data_late)
m_late_full   <- lm(log_income ~ chinese + AGE + sex_label + race_label, 
                    data = data_late)

modelsummary(list("2000-2004, No Controls" = m_early_simple,
                  "2000-2004, With Controls" = m_early_full,
                  "2020-2024, No Controls" = m_late_simple,
                  "2020-2024, With Controls" = m_late_full),
             coef_map = c("chinese" = "Speaks Chinese",
                          "AGE" = "Age",
                          "sex_labelFemale" = "Female",
                          "race_labelBlack" = "Black",
                          "race_labelAmerican Indian/Alaska Native" = "Indigenous",
                          "race_labelChinese" = "Asian, Chinese",
                          "race_labelJapanese" = "Asian, Japanese",
                          "race_labelOther Asian/Pacific Islander" = "AAPI",
                          "race_labelOther race" = "Other",
                          "race_labelTwo races" = "Biracial",
                          "race_labelThree+ races" = "Multiracial (3+)"),
             stars = TRUE,
             statistic = "({std.error})",
             gof_map = c("nobs"))
```

```{r}
coef_data <- data.frame(
  model = factor(c("No Controls", "+ Age", "+ Sex", "+ Race", "+ Year"),
                 levels = c("No Controls", "+ Age", "+ Sex", "+ Race", "+ Year")),
  estimate = c(coef(m1)["chinese"],
               coef(m2)["chinese"],
               coef(m3)["chinese"],
               coef(m4)["chinese"],
               coef(m5)["chinese"]),
  se = c(summary(m1)$coefficients["chinese", "Std. Error"],
         summary(m2)$coefficients["chinese", "Std. Error"],
         summary(m3)$coefficients["chinese", "Std. Error"],
         summary(m4)$coefficients["chinese", "Std. Error"],
         summary(m5)$coefficients["chinese", "Std. Error"]))

coef_data$ci_low  <- coef_data$estimate - 1.96 * coef_data$se
coef_data$ci_high <- coef_data$estimate + 1.96 * coef_data$se

ggplot(coef_data, aes(x = model, y = estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), 
                  size = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.5, linetype = "dotted", color = "firebrick", alpha = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.6, y = 0.27, label = "Race added ->", 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Association Between Chinese Language Use and Log Income",
       subtitle = "Coefficient on 'Speaks Chinese at Home' across nested OLS models",
       x = "Iteration",
       y = "Coefficient (log income)",
       caption = "95% confidence intervals shown. N = 500,000. Data: IPUMS ACS 2000-2024.") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40"))
```
